svg.title: Gather round: Pix by the campfire
svg.desc: Pixel-art night scene: a starry sky with a crescent moon, mountains and a pine treeline. In the clearing a campfire crackles inside a stone ring, sparks rise and smoke drifts up. An empty log bench waits on the left; Pix, the little pixel mascot, sits on the right, lit warm by the fire, and blinks.
